subject: Re: Tuesday appointment
text:
Hey,

Thanks for your last note. I had to double-check my calendar after reading it, and things are still shifting a bit on my end. I don’t think the original appointment time will work for me anymore, but I’m not trying to make this more difficult than it needs to be.

Would next Thursday morning be possible? Around ten would be ideal, though I can move things if that feels too early. I can also do the following Tuesday afternoon if that is easier for everyone else. I know I mentioned earlier that the current slot was fine, so I appreciate you sticking with me while the plans changed.

If you need to lock something in today, I can work with what you already have available. I’d just hate for us to meet while I’m still dealing with a lingering phone call.

Let me know what lands best, and I’ll clear the space. Thanks for being patient with my back-and-forth.
